title: Claude Agent SDK (Rust): SDK-hosted in-process MCP servers (tool + createSdkMcpServer)
body:
Add the Rust equivalent of the TS SDK's `tool()` + `createSdkMcpServer()` to `crates/claude_agent_sdk`: custom tools defined in Rust that run inside the host process.

- `SdkMcpServer` builder (name, version, `.tool(name, description, input_schema, async handler)`), `ToolResult` with text, image and `is_error` content.
- `QueryOptions::sdk_mcp_server` registers it in `initialize.sdkMcpServers` (plus `sdkMcpServerConfigs`, optional `sdkMcpServerManifests`).
- Route `mcp_message` control requests to it and answer per JSON-RPC (initialize, tools/list, tools/call, ping, notifications).
- `mcp__<server>__<tool>` names for `allowed_tools`.
- Unit tests, fake-CLI tests, a live smoke example, PARITY.md and README.

Needed by the briefed agent in #11211.
